thread:
Leah: Noticed a subtle issue this morning: several tenants were silently served v1 while sending v2 headers, but the console only logged a generic "route error". Customers hit semantic regressions and didn't know why.
Marco: Oof. Is this the same fallback->v1 behavior we've seen before? Any new root cause?
Leah: Mostly capacity-induced switches and a couple of quantization variant failures. But the user-visible problem is we have zero visible signal in the console unless we mark a route as 'deprecated'.
metrics-bot: spike: implicit_version_switch_total{route="/chat-stream",tenant="acme-inc"} +34 in 7m.
Yara: We should treat silent downgrades as a first-class telemetry signal. Proposal: emit `version_routing_event` with labels {tenant,route,incoming_version,routed_version,reason}. That lets dashboards and billing reflect reality.
Devon: Agree. UX: add a non-modal per-route "health row" showing three stats: current_version_ratio (pct requests hitting requested version), recent_fallbacks, and stability_score. Not a banner — more of a neutral health indicator.
Marco: For alerts, I suggest combining absolute and relative thresholds: fire when recent_fallbacks > 10 in 10m AND recent_fallbacks > 3x median(last_7d,10m). That avoids transient noise during deploys.
Leah: Could also use an exponential decay window so older spikes don't mask current issues: stability_score = sum(decay_weight(t) * fallback_event).
Yara: We should also generate a per-model heatmap: rows=model_hash, cols=time-bins, color=fallback-rate. Helps spot model-specific regressions across tenants.
Devon: Ops wants prescriptive actions in alerts: e.g., "Investigate: model OOM? view autoscaler events; consider pinning route to v2 for 30m: `rwctl pin --tenant acme-inc --route /chat-stream --ver v2 --ttl 30m`."
metrics-bot: note: metric `version_routing_event` created (dry-run).
Marco: One more thought: we could test a synthetic-probe approach. Emit small golden requests periodically to each tenant's v2 pool to validate semantic parity. If probes fail, surface immediate warning.
Leah: Watch out for customer data boundaries. Use synthetic public probes or customer-provided testsets opt-in.
Yara: Console affordance: add a toggle per-org: "aggressive visibility" (show global banners when any tenant-level instability) vs default "scoped badges only". Default to scoped.
Devon: Also consider a temporary circuit-breaker that prevents repeated silent downgrades for a single request stream — maybe deny downgrade if same client IP had a downgrade in last 2m unless forced. That reduces flapping.
Marco: Telemetry PR plan: 1) finalise `version_routing_event` schema 2) add derived `stability_score` and `current_version_ratio` aggregates 3) build heatmap + per-route health row 4) probe-mode alerting for 72h 5) add audit events and billing annotation 6) iterate on thresholds.
Leah: I'll own the audit + billing annotation piece. Marco take metrics, Yara take console mock, Devon owns runbook and circuit-breaker feasibility.
Devon: I'll prototype the circuit-breaker parameters and share a short failure-mode doc.
Leah: Let's run probe-mode over the weekend and reconvene Monday 10:00 to look at signals.
